opportunities.title: Henry Moore Grant – Autumn 2026 round
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications are open to UK and international non‑profit organisations for new projects, commissions, acquisitions, collections, conferences, lectures, publications, and long‑term research. Individuals may apply only for Research and Travel grants (sculpture historians, academics, conservators). Organisations must be registered.
opportunities.summary: Grants support the growth and development of sculpture across historical, modern and contemporary registers, funding exhibitions, commissions, acquisitions, research, conferences and publications.
